verses.ar: أَمَّا شَاوُلُ فَكَانَ لَمْ يَزَلْ يَنْفُثُ تَهَدُّدًا وَقَتْلًا عَلَى تَلَامِيذِ ٱلرَّبِّ، فَتَقَدَّمَ إِلَى رَئِيسِ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ
verses.kjv: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
verses.web: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

verses.ar: وَطَلَبَ مِنْهُ رَسَائِلَ إِلَى دِمَشْقَ، إِلَى ٱلْجَمَاعَاتِ، حَتَّى إِذَا وَجَدَ أُنَاسًا مِنَ ٱلطَّرِيقِ، رِجَالًا أَوْ نِسَاءً، يَسُوقُهُمْ مُوثَقِينَ إِلَى أُورُشَلِيمَ.
verses.kjv: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
verses.web: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

verses.ar: وَفِي ذَهَابِهِ حَدَثَ أَنَّهُ ٱقْتَرَبَ إِلَى دِمَشْقَ فَبَغْتَةً أَبْرَقَ حَوْلَهُ نُورٌ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ،
verses.kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
verses.web: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

verses.ar: فَسَقَطَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَسَمِعَ صَوْتًا قَائِلًا لَهُ: «شَاوُلُ، شَاوُلُ! لِمَاذَا تَضْطَهِدُنِي؟».
verses.kjv: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
verses.web: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ: «مَنْ أَنْتَ يَا سَيِّدُ؟». فَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ: «أَنَا يَسُوعُ ٱلَّذِي أَنْتَ تَضْطَهِدُهُ. صَعْبٌ عَلَيْكَ أَن تَرْفُسَ مَنَاخِسَ».
verses.kjv: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: [it is] hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
verses.web: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ وَهُوَ مُرْتَعِدٌ وَمُتَحَيِّرٌ: «يَارَبُّ، مَاذَا تُرِيدُ أَنْ أَفْعَلَ؟». فَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ: «قُمْ وَٱدْخُلِ ٱلْمَدِينَةَ فَيُقَالَ لَكَ مَاذَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ تَفْعَلَ».
verses.kjv: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord [said] unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
verses.web: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلرِّجَالُ ٱلْمُسَافِرُونَ مَعَهُ فَوَقَفُوا صَامِتِينَ، يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّوْتَ وَلَا يَنْظُرُونَ أَحَدًا.
verses.kjv: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
verses.web: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

verses.ar: فَنَهَضَ شَاوُلُ عَنِ ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَكَانَ وَهُوَ مَفْتُوحُ ٱلْعَيْنَيْنِ لَا يُبْصِرُ أَحَدًا. فَٱقْتَادُوهُ بِيَدِهِ وَأَدْخَلُوهُ إِلَى دِمَشْقَ.
verses.kjv: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought [him] into Damascus.
verses.web: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ لَا يُبْصِرُ، فَلَمْ يَأْكُلْ وَلَمْ يَشْرَبْ.
verses.kjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
verses.web: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ فِي دِمَشْقَ تِلْمِيذٌ ٱسْمُهُ حَنَانِيَّا، فَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ فِي رُؤْيَا: «يَا حَنَانِيَّا!». فَقَالَ: «هَأَنَذَا يَارَبُّ».
verses.kjv: ¶ And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I [am here], Lord.
verses.web: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ: «قُمْ وَٱذْهَبْ إِلَى ٱلزُّقَاقِ ٱلَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمُ، وَٱطْلُبْ فِي بَيْتِ يَهُوذَا رَجُلًا طَرْسُوسِيًّا ٱسْمُهُ شَاوُلُ. لِأَنَّهُ هُوَذَا يُصَلِّي،
verses.kjv: And the Lord [said] unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for [one] called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
verses.web: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

verses.ar: وَقَدْ رَأَى فِي رُؤْيَا رَجُلًا ٱسْمُهُ حَنَانِيَّا دَاخِلًا وَوَاضِعًا يَدَهُ عَلَيْهِ لِكَيْ يُبْصِرَ».
verses.kjv: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting [his] hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
verses.web: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”

verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ حَنَانِيَّا: «يَارَبُّ، قَدْ سَمِعْتُ مِنْ كَثِيرِينَ عَنْ هَذَا ٱلرَّجُلِ، كَمْ مِنَ ٱلشُّرُورِ فَعَلَ بِقِدِّيسِيكَ فِي أُورُشَلِيمَ.
verses.kjv: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
verses.web: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

verses.ar: وَهَهُنَا لَهُ سُلْطَانٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ رُؤَسَاءِ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ أَنْ يُوثِقَ جَمِيعَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ بِٱسْمِكَ».
verses.kjv: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
verses.web: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ: «ٱذْهَبْ! لِأَنَّ هَذَا لِي إِنَاءٌ مُخْتَارٌ لِيَحْمِلَ ٱسْمِي أَمَامَ أُمَمٍ وَمُلُوكٍ وَبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
verses.web: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي سَأُرِيهِ كَمْ يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يَتَأَلَّمَ مِنْ أَجْلِ ٱسْمِي».
verses.kjv: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name’s sake.
verses.web: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”

verses.ar: فَمَضَى حَنَانِيَّا وَدَخَلَ ٱلْبَيْتَ وَوَضَعَ عَلَيْهِ يَدَيْهِ وَقَالَ: «أَيُّهَا ٱلْأَخُ شَاوُلُ، قَدْ أَرْسَلَنِي ٱلرَّبُّ يَسُوعُ ٱلَّذِي ظَهَرَ لَكَ فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ ٱلَّذِي جِئْتَ فِيهِ، لِكَيْ تُبْصِرَ وَتَمْتَلِئَ مِنَ ٱلرُّوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ».
verses.kjv: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, [even] Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
verses.web: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

verses.ar: فَلِلْوَقْتِ وَقَعَ مِنْ عَيْنَيْهِ شَيْءٌ كَأَنَّهُ قُشُورٌ، فَأَبْصَرَ فِي ٱلْحَالِ، وَقَامَ وَٱعْتَمَدَ.
verses.kjv: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
verses.web: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

verses.ar: وَتَنَاوَلَ طَعَامًا فَتَقَوَّى. وَكَانَ شَاوُلُ مَعَ ٱلتَّلَامِيذِ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي دِمَشْقَ أَيَّامًا.
verses.kjv: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
verses.web: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

verses.ar: وَلِلْوَقْتِ جَعَلَ يَكْرِزُ فِي ٱلْمَجَامِعِ بِٱلْمَسِيحِ: «أَنْ هَذَا هُوَ ٱبْنُ ٱللهِ».
verses.kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
verses.web: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

verses.ar: فَبُهِتَ جَمِيعُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا يَسْمَعُونَ وَقَالُوا: «أَلَيْسَ هَذَا هُوَ ٱلَّذِي أَهْلَكَ فِي أُورُشَلِيمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ بِهَذَا ٱلِٱسْمِ؟ وَقَدْ جَاءَ إِلَى هُنَا لِهَذا لِيَسُوقَهُمْ مُوثَقِينَ إِلَى رُؤَسَاءِ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ!».
verses.kjv: But all that heard [him] were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
verses.web: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا شَاوُلُ فَكَانَ يَزْدَادُ قُوَّةً، وَيُحَيِّرُ ٱلْيَهُودَ ٱلسَّاكِنِينَ فِي دِمَشْقَ مُحَقِّقًا: «أَنَّ هَذَا هُوَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ».
verses.kjv: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
verses.web: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا تَمَّتْ أَيَّامٌ كَثِيرَةٌ تَشَاوَرَ ٱلْيَهُودُ لِيَقْتُلُوهُ،
verses.kjv: ¶ And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
verses.web: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

verses.ar: فَعَلِمَ شَاوُلُ بِمَكِيدَتِهِمْ. وَكَانُوا يُرَاقِبُونَ ٱلْأَبْوَابَ أَيْضًا نَهَارًا وَلَيْلًا لِيَقْتُلُوهُ.
verses.kjv: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
verses.web: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

verses.ar: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱلتَّلَامِيذُ لَيْلًا وَأَنْزَلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلسُّورِ مُدَلِّينَ إِيَّاهُ فِي سَلٍّ.
verses.kjv: Then the disciples took him by night, and let [him] down by the wall in a basket.
verses.web: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ شَاوُلُ إِلَى أُورُشَلِيمَ حَاوَلَ أَنْ يَلْتَصِقَ بِٱلتَّلَامِيذِ، وَكَانَ ٱلْجَمِيعُ يَخَافُونَهُ غَيْرَ مُصَدِّقِينَ أَنَّهُ تِلْمِيذٌ.
verses.kjv: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
verses.web: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

verses.ar: فَأَخَذَهُ بَرْنَابَا وَأَحْضَرَهُ إِلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ، وَحَدَّثَهُمْ كَيْفَ أَبْصَرَ ٱلرَّبَّ فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ وَأَنَّهُ كَلَّمَهُ، وَكَيْفَ جَاهَرَ فِي دِمَشْقَ بِٱسْمِ يَسُوعَ.
verses.kjv: But Barnabas took him, and brought [him] to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
verses.web: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

verses.ar: فَكَانَ مَعَهُمْ يَدْخُلُ وَيَخْرُجُ فِي أُورُشَلِيمَ وَيُجَاهِرُ بِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ يَسُوعَ.
verses.kjv: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
verses.web: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,

verses.ar: وَكَانَ يُخَاطِبُ وَيُبَاحِثُ ٱلْيُونَانِيِّينَ، فَحَاوَلُوا أَنْ يَقْتُلُوهُ.
verses.kjv: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
verses.web: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا عَلِمَ ٱلْإِخْوَةُ أَحْدَرُوهُ إِلَى قَيْصَرِيَّةَ وَأَرْسَلُوهُ إِلَى طَرْسُوسَ.
verses.kjv: [Which] when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Cæsarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
verses.web: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْكَنَائِسُ فِي جَمِيعِ ٱلْيَهُودِيَّةِ وَٱلْجَلِيلِ وَٱلسَّامِرَةِ فَكَانَ لَهَا سَلَامٌ، وَكَانَتْ تُبْنَى وَتَسِيرُ فِي خَوْفِ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَبِتَعْزِيَةِ ٱلرُّوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ كَانَتْ تَتَكَاثَرُ.
verses.kjv: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judæa and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
verses.web: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

verses.ar: وَحَدَثَ أَنَّ بُطْرُسَ وَهُوَ يَجْتَازُ بِٱلْجَمِيعِ، نَزَلَ أَيْضًا إِلَى ٱلْقِدِّيسِينَ ٱلسَّاكِنِينَ فِي لُدَّةَ،
verses.kjv: ¶ And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all [quarters], he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
verses.web: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

verses.ar: فَوَجَدَ هُنَاكَ إِنْسَانًا ٱسْمُهُ إِينِيَاسُ مُضْطَجِعًا عَلَى سَرِيرٍ مُنْذُ ثَمَانِي سِنِينَ، وَكَانَ مَفْلُوجًا.
verses.kjv: And there he found a certain man named Æneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
verses.web: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُ بُطْرُسُ: «يَا إِينِيَاسُ، يَشْفِيكَ يَسُوعُ ٱلْمَسِيحُ. قُمْ وَٱفْرُشْ لِنَفْسِكَ!». فَقَامَ لِلْوَقْتِ.
verses.kjv: And Peter said unto him, Æneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
verses.web: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

verses.ar: وَرَآهُ جَمِيعُ ٱلسَّاكِنِينَ فِي لُدَّةَ وَسَارُونَ، ٱلَّذِينَ رَجَعُوا إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
verses.web: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ فِي يَافَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ ٱسْمُهَا طَابِيثَا، ٱلَّذِي تَرْجَمَتُهُ غَزَالَةُ. هَذِهِ كَانَتْ مُمْتَلِئَةً أَعْمَالًا صَالِحَةً وَإِحْسَانَاتٍ كَانَتْ تَعْمَلُهَا.
verses.kjv: ¶ Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
verses.web: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

verses.ar: وَحَدَثَ فِي تِلْكَ ٱلْأَيَّامِ أَنَّهَا مَرِضَتْ وَمَاتَتْ، فَغَسَّلُوهَا وَوَضَعُوهَا فِي عِلِّيَّةٍ.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid [ her] in an upper chamber.
verses.web: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ كَانَتْ لُدَّةُ قَرِيبَةً مِنْ يَافَا، وَسَمِعَ ٱلتَّلَامِيذُ أَنَّ بُطْرُسَ فِيهَا، أَرْسَلُوا رَجُلَيْنِ يَطْلُبَانِ إِلَيْهِ أَنْ لَا يَتَوَانَى عَنْ أَنْ يَجْتَازَ إِلَيْهِمْ.
verses.kjv: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring [him] that he would not delay to come to them.
verses.web: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

verses.ar: فَقَامَ بُطْرُسُ وَجَاءَ مَعَهُمَا. فَلَمَّا وَصَلَ صَعِدُوا بِهِ إِلَى ٱلْعِلِّيَّةِ، فَوَقَفَتْ لَدَيْهِ جَمِيعُ ٱلْأَرَامِلِ يَبْكِينَ وَيُرِينَ أَقْمِصَةً وَثِيَابًا مِمَّا كَانَتْ تَعْمَلُ غَزَالَةُ وَهِيَ مَعَهُنَّ.
verses.kjv: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
verses.web: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

verses.ar: فَأَخْرَجَ بُطْرُسُ ٱلْجَمِيعَ خَارِجًا، وَجَثَا عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ وَصَلَّى، ثُمَّ ٱلْتَفَتَ إِلَى ٱلْجَسَدِ وَقَالَ: «يَا طَابِيثَا، قُومِي!». فَفَتَحَتْ عَيْنَيْهَا. وَلَمَّا أَبْصَرَتْ بُطْرُسَ جَلَسَتْ،
verses.kjv: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning [him] to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
verses.web: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

verses.ar: فَنَاوَلَهَا يَدَهُ وَأَقَامَهَا. ثُمَّ نَادَى ٱلْقِدِّيسِينَ وَٱلْأَرَامِلَ وَأَحْضَرَهَا حَيَّةً.
verses.kjv: And he gave her [his] hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
verses.web: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

verses.ar: فَصَارَ ذَلِكَ مَعْلُومًا فِي يَافَا كُلِّهَا، فَآمَنَ كَثِيرُونَ بِٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
verses.web: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

verses.ar: وَمَكَثَ أَيَّامًا كَثِيرَةً فِي يَافَا، عِنْدَ سِمْعَانَ رَجُلٍ دَبَّاغٍ.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
verses.web: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
